Source decision: existing full-context probe inherently needs MTP and captures/restores main+draft state. It cannot be used unchanged with strict noMTP/noRESTORE layer-major. A separate target-only arm under the existing flag fills exactly 262144 rows, has zero generation, no successor token access, no head prediction, no snapshot and no RESTORE. Ordinary MTP probe remains unchanged in behavior. Layer-major CLI keeps fresh/noBorrow/noSplit/noReuse/noCheckpoint restrictions, and probe-specific admission requires physical262144, int8/resident32768, noMTP, phase0/head0/scratchAlias0 and explicit700MiB reserve. Actual Prefill probe opt-in rejects missing on_chunk and wrong actual span/capacity before bridge/cache allocation. Final-layer callbacks validate contiguous completion, final chunk, and total stats. Existing run_impl stream-sync callback guard and layer-major checked drain/owner ordering are retained. No numeric kernel, dtype or ordinary KV-policy changes.

CPU fixture source only: exact-capacity/missingcallback/pos0/below/above guards, planner physical full and near-boundary page tails1/2/3, GPU32768/RAM tail mapping, final partial/full chunk, and one-past-span rejection. Paired EN/JA docs explain target-only semantics and independent RESTORE requirement.

Check CLI rejection before allocation for MTP, phase/head lease, wrong reserve, context32768, near/full count mismatch and reuse/dumps. Run paired physical262144 exact exhaustion on pinned baseline/candidate with matching model/input/config, record zero generated output and final_pos262143, checked callbacks/chunks/lastpage, normal owner closure or refusal/fault status. Do not shrink reserve or context on failed admission. Near-boundary ordinary GEN remains separate with final partial chunk/page and final legal position. R398/R402 source invariants need real PLE/QSA/GDN/residual/head and fault qualification; R406 calls for fixed-history complete-vocabulary numerical pairing. RESTORE remains rejected until a separate explicit all-state contract and uninterrupted-vs-restored numerical comparison is implemented. No256K/quality/fit/speed/fault claim is made here.
